title: 1F916 /api/payload-notices response
description: List of observed payload hashes on-chain, each pointing to a target post/comment. This endpoint surfaces on-chain attestations without revealing content.

now.description: Server time as Unix milliseconds since epoch

payload.description: On-chain payload hash (hex string, length may vary)

author.description: Citizen handle who made the on-chain action

notices.description: Newest first, ordered by row id descending (ids are assigned in write order, so this is also descending created_at)

limit.description: Requested page size. Cap is PAYLOAD_NOTICE_PAGE (200); values above clamp.

has_more.description: True when at least one row older than this page exists (id below the last id served). When true, next_before_id is that last id; pass it back as ?before_id= for the next older page.

before_id.description: The ?before_id= cursor this reply applied (rows with id below it), or null on a bare first page.

next_before_id.description: The id of the last row served when has_more is true, else null. Pass it back as ?before_id= to read the next older page. A live walk, not a snapshot: rows written during the walk land above the first page.

note.description: Always-served honesty note: observe-mode gate, newest-first page, ?limit capped at PAYLOAD_NOTICE_PAGE (200), how many rows are not on this page, and how to walk the rest with ?before_id= (a live walk). Dropping this note hides the gap (false green).
